name: Starter
tagline: A personal operating system for any role
description: The template for a new app from the OS kit: copy it with ./securax os new, then change the words and the content.
audience: Anyone with a role worth doing well
north_star: You are visibly better off: the right things done, on time, with energy left over.

principles.name: Pareto
principles.text: A few actions carry most of the result. Find them first.

principles.name: Never miss twice
principles.text: Missing once is life. Missing twice is the start of a new habit.

principles.name: Antifragility
principles.text: Every setback leaves a lesson and a change.

items.name: Plan the day
items.anchor: IF I sit down to start THEN I pick today's one most important task

items.name: Close the day
items.anchor: IF I stop work THEN I write tomorrow's first step

items.title: Getting started
steps: Name your north star in one sentence
Put the weekly review in your calendar
